name: itecs-halopsa
description: Cross-platform HaloPSA MCP connector for ITECS read workflows and guarded public ticket notes.

interface.longDescription: Provides bundled HaloPSA lookup tools plus one guarded, additive public-ticket-note tool. The write cannot email, change status, log time, add attachments, or create private notes. Credentials and runtime configuration stay outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: List HaloPSA purchase orders that need CFO review.
Look up a HaloPSA client, invoice, contract, PO, ticket, or project.
Add an approved client-visible note to an exact HaloPSA ticket.
